lines: Ramrod beat the living shit out of Rebuilding Morehouse’s, 196.4 to 36.1. That's not a matchup, that's a fucking crime scene.
Wilson Weasels dropped 216.0 in week 10. Hottest fucking lineup in the league, and they won't shut up about it.
Rebuilding Morehouse’s put up a pathetic 36.1. A kicker and a prayer would've scored more.
DetroitDumpsterFire left 19.5 points rotting on the bench with Cam Skattebo sitting there while Dylan Sampson took a dump. Benching genius.
SaquonMyPickens scored 170.9 and still fucking lost. The fantasy gods took a dump on that roster.
